dcterms:description: The DANIEL corpus contains articles in multiple languages: English, Greek, Russian, and Polish. It includes 474 articles in English, 390 in Greek, 352 in Polish, and 426 in Russian, used for detecting occurrences of disease names and location names describing epidemic events.
